title: Parrot 2025 full-year earnings
excerpt: For 2025 Parrot reported EUR 79.8m revenue, EUR 60.1m gross margin, EUR 12.7m operating loss, EUR 15.0m net loss, EUR 7.6m operating cash outflow, and EUR 23.0m year-end cash. Second-half ordinary operations were slightly positive at EUR 0.2m.
summary: Primary issuer release dated 2026-03-27 with FY2025 income statement, balance sheet, cash flow, segment results, and outlook. Revenue and gross margin improved and second-half operations broke even, but full-year losses and cash burn persisted. A shareholder facility had EUR 5.0m outstanding and was expanded to EUR 20.0m through February 2028. The release does not provide the complete diluted-share and customer/order-concentration inputs required for a downside-aware common-equity valuation.
